cluster_label: main body follicle cell ca. until St. 5
working_definition: Main body follicle cells of early egg chambers (up to about stage 5) in the adult ovary (Li et al. 2022, Fly Cell Atlas). Annotated by the authors with FBbt:00005402 'main body follicle cell'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Follicle cell that overlies the oocyte (Wu et al., 2008). Along with the posterior terminal follicle cells they form a columnar epithelium from stage 10, which deposits eggshell components (Wu et al., 2008). These cells are connected to one another by ring canals (Airoldi et al., 2011).

justification: The authors' own term FBbt:00005402 is current and non-obsolete, with no adult-specific variant or stage-specific child. The label adds an early-stage bin that FBbt does not capture, so the cell type is mapped at the type level (stage bin of the lineage).
recommendation: Keep the authors' term main body follicle cell (FBbt:00005402); stage bin so broad match.
